account: ERT, Greece's public broadcaster, reported on 28 August 2025 that 45 firefighters, 13 vehicles, two planes and four helicopters had been sent to the fire at Diavologefyro near Troizina, and that footage showed the fire close to houses. Contemporary reporting by Saronic Magazine describes the fire spreading uphill, hours of firefighting, precautionary evacuations and damage to a shed. The municipality’s statement that evening credits a coordinated response involving more than 80 firefighters and six aircraft. It thanks the fire service, the police and volunteers and credits cooperation among agencies. It does not mention the cameras. These accounts establish the scale of the fire and the response, and none of them verifies the AI’s contribution. WINGS reported on 2 September 2025 that its wi.breathe cameras in Methana had detected the wildfire in Troizina on 28 August and alerted authorities. The company quoted Mayor Tasos Ath. Mougios crediting the system with preventing a larger disaster. The mayor's credit to wi.breathe appears only in this WINGS release. No alert log, detection time, response chronology or estimate of avoided damage accompanies that account. WINGS later announced completion of the wider camera installation on 12 May 2026. Circulated completion publicity gives a one-minute detection figure; that figure describes the system's capability, and no source measures it for the August fire.

ai_role.statement: WINGS reports that its system detected the fire through the Methana cameras and issued real-time alerts, and the mayor credits the system in WINGS's release. The municipality's own statement on the day credits more than 80 firefighters, six aircraft in action within 30 minutes, the police and volunteers, and it does not mention the cameras. No source gives the time of the AI alert or compares it with the first call to the fire service, so the AI's share in the response is unknown.

fields.account: ERT, Greece's public broadcaster, reported on 28 August 2025 that 45 firefighters, 13 vehicles, two planes and four helicopters had been sent to the fire at Diavologefyro near Troizina, and that footage showed the fire close to houses. Contemporary reporting by Saronic Magazine describes the fire spreading uphill, hours of firefighting, precautionary evacuations and damage to a shed. The municipality’s statement that evening credits a coordinated response involving more than 80 firefighters and six aircraft. It thanks the fire service, the police and volunteers and credits cooperation among agencies. It does not mention the cameras. These accounts establish the scale of the fire and the response, and none of them verifies the AI’s contribution. WINGS reported on 2 September 2025 that its wi.breathe cameras in Methana had detected the wildfire in Troizina on 28 August and alerted authorities. The company quoted Mayor Tasos Ath. Mougios crediting the system with preventing a larger disaster. The mayor's credit to wi.breathe appears only in this WINGS release. No alert log, detection time, response chronology or estimate of avoided damage accompanies that account. WINGS later announced completion of the wider camera installation on 12 May 2026. Circulated completion publicity gives a one-minute detection figure; that figure describes the system's capability, and no source measures it for the August fire.
fields.summary: WINGS says that its wi.breathe cameras and AI smoke and fire detector alerted authorities to a Troizina wildfire on 28 August 2025; the municipality's statement that day does not mention them.
